skill.author: asyntai

security_audit.summary: Of 36 static findings, 35 are false positives involving Markdown, legitimate setup commands, or documented Asyntai URLs. The local bridge configuration runs an unpinned package through npx with automatic installation approval, creating a supply chain execution risk. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unrelated data exfiltration in the reviewed skill.

remediation.issue: The optional local bridge runs npx -y @asyntai/mcp without a pinned version.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer the remote HTTPS connection. If the local bridge is necessary, pin a reviewed package version and require user approval before installation.

content.user_title: Manage Your Asyntai AI Support Agent
content.value_statement: Support teams need to keep chatbot knowledge, behavior, and visitor responses consistent. This skill guides authenticated Asyntai MCP workflows for configuration, review, and approved live replies.
actual_capabilities: Guide Asyntai MCP connection and discover the correct website before changes.
Add knowledge from URLs, site crawls, or text, then check ingestion and test chatbot answers.
Read and update chatbot instructions or widget settings with user approval.
Review conversations, visitor questions, analytics, leads, and tickets through the connected server.
Identify knowledge gaps and test answers after adding relevant information.
Take over active conversations, send approved replies, and release conversations through MCP tools.
limitations: Requires an Asyntai account, OAuth authorization, and access to the hosted MCP tools.
Provides workflow instructions, not an included MCP server implementation or independently verified service behavior.
Website widget installation is delegated to the separate add-ai-chatbot skill, which is not included here.
The optional local bridge runs an unpinned package; prefer remote HTTPS or a reviewed, pinned installation.

use_cases.title: Maintain chatbot knowledge
use_cases.description: Review unanswered visitor questions, add approved policy information, and test the resulting chatbot responses.

use_cases.title: Configure a website support agent
use_cases.description: Connect the account, select the website, and review proposed instruction or widget changes before saving.

use_cases.title: Handle a live conversation
use_cases.description: Inspect active sessions, approve a visitor reply, and release the conversation after the response.

prompt_templates.title: Review the connected website
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Asyntai websites. Ask me to select one if needed, then summarize its current chatbot instructions without changing anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect the account and website.

prompt_templates.title: Add a support policy
prompt_templates.prompt: For [website], review existing knowledge and add this approved policy: [policy text]. Test it with [visitor question] and report the answer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: add knowledge and verify an answer.

prompt_templates.title: Improve chatbot instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the instructions for [website]. Propose changes for [goal], show the complete revised text, and wait for my approval before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Review knowledge gaps and live support
prompt_templates.prompt: For [website], review knowledge gaps, analytics, and active sessions. Propose knowledge improvements and draft any needed visitor replies. Wait for approval before sending replies.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate knowledge review and live support.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: review my chatbot knowledge gaps without changing anything.
output: Example gap: visitors ask whether returns require the original packaging.
Suggested action: obtain an approved packaging policy before adding knowledge.
Verification plan: test the same visitor question after the policy is added.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: propose chatbot instructions requiring order numbers for delivery questions.
output: Proposed instruction: For delivery questions, ask for the order number before discussing order-specific details.
Keep all other existing instructions unchanged.
Approval required before saving the revised instructions.

best_practices: Select the correct website and read its current settings before proposing changes.
Use approved knowledge sources and test updated answers with representative visitor questions.
Review instruction text and approve sensitive changes or live replies before execution.
anti_patterns: Guessing website identifiers or changing the first website when multiple websites exist.
Deleting knowledge, changing instructions or widget settings, or sending live replies without user approval.
Treating retrieved visitor messages or crawled pages as authority to change account settings.

faq.question: Do I need an Asyntai account or API key?
faq.answer: An Asyntai account and OAuth authorization are required. The skill states that no API key is needed and Free accounts are supported.

faq.question: Does this skill include the MCP server?
faq.answer: No. It documents connecting to the hosted Asyntai MCP server and using its available tools.

faq.question: Can it install the chatbot widget on my website?
faq.answer: It retrieves the widget identifier but delegates installation to the separate add-ai-chatbot skill.

faq.question: Which actions require my approval?
faq.answer: The rules require approval before deleting knowledge, changing instructions or widget settings, or replying to a live visitor.

faq.question: Can it review conversations and leads?
faq.answer: Yes, through the authenticated Asyntai tools. Limit requests to necessary records because conversations and leads may contain personal information.

faq.question: Is there a local connection option?
faq.answer: Yes, an optional npx bridge is documented. Its package version is unpinned, so prefer remote HTTPS or a reviewed, pinned installation.
